threshold.status: new engineering target, not a measured baseline or SRS threshold

toolCompatibility: Every gate run verifies exact pinned tools and matching LLVM versions. A completed instrumented test/report run, with numbered receipts and versions.json, establishes compatibility; provisioning alone does not.

source.roots: all seven current crates/*/src trees; immutable historical baselines contain six
source.canonical: realpath, workspace-relative slash paths, SHA-256 file bytes
source.inputs: Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml, mise.toml, package.json, every crates/ file, scripts/coverage/ file, contract/accounting.json and any root .cargo config/build.rs
source.baselineMeaning: accepted committed source only; Actor task edits remain local until integrated

accounting.lineUnit: unique canonical source file plus LLVM LCOV DA line number
accounting.merge: union of mapped DA line numbers; hit if any compilation instance has positive hits; never average binaries or count repeated modules twice
accounting.zeroHit: retain every zero-hit production DA line
accounting.testOnly: omit src items whose cfg expression is provably false with test disabled; omit files reachable exclusively through test-only modules or Cargo integration-test roots
accounting.production: retain all production modules, including source recompiled using path attributes in test targets
accounting.unknown: reject unclassified source, unknown LCOV files outside explicitly recognized integration-test directories, missing production files, malformed records and any crate with zero denominator
accounting.inactive: host compiler cfg controls executable mapping; inactive platform source stays inventoried and is unmeasured, never represented as covered
accounting.noMappedLines: a present production file may have zero DA lines; all files must be present and every crate needs positive total
accounting.upstreamFilters: Disable cargo-llvm-cov default filename filters; ignore only exact non-workspace dependency package roots from locked Cargo metadata, Rust sysroot and its compiler source hash. Retain path-included production modules even when recorded paths contain tests/../src.
accounting.recordValidation: Standalone LCOV requires safe LF/LH exactly matching DA counts. Real LLVM 22.1.2 exports additionally require a fresh schema-3.1.0 JSON export: exact source-file set, LF/LH equal its function-group summary, and every DA line/count exactly equal a line map reconstructed from its ordered native segments. No summary is used as the unique-source denominator. Malformed counts, missing/extra lines/files, duplicate records or mismatched summaries fail before canonical merging.

profiles.children: existing integration child binaries inherit instrumentation; extra real arcctl help and daemon startup-failure probes record PIDs
profiles.mergeProof: exact equality between fresh raw profile inventory and pinned cargo-llvm-cov llvm-profdata input list, including explicit child PIDs

reports.raw: raw.lcov and raw.json: both native exports from the same fresh profile merge; neither is rewritten
reports.summary: summary.json with schemaVersion=1, sourceHash, rawSha256, llvmSha256, runId, acceptedBaseline, host, versions, seven current crates and per-file mapped/uncovered/omitted lines
reports.profiles: profiles.json with binary, PID, raw filenames, hashes and exact merge list
reports.commands: numbered command JSON receipts with argv, cwd, times, PID, exit, stdout and stderr
reports.verdict: receipt.json for every attempt, including prerequisites failure; latest.json always overwritten with current outcome
reports.freshness: new run-specific paths, both native report mtimes after collection start, and identical before/after full input hashes

failurePolicy: nonzero for missing/mismatched tools, failed tests, child-profile failure, missing/stale/malformed reports, missing crates/files or any below-target crate; no implicit installs and no prior passing-report fallback

platformBoundaries.executedHost: Host and target recorded per real measurement in versions.json and summary.json; only active compiler cfg is measured.
inactiveInventory: arc-core/src/lib.rs: non-macOS runtime path, Windows LOCALAPPDATA branch, non-macOS XDG branch
arc-daemon/src/platform.rs: Linux peer credentials and other-Unix unsupported fallback
